reviewedScope: Independent inspection of the root-authored two-line correction; not an independent re-audit of the whole reader or a runtime execution.

checks.name: exact_two_line_delta
checks.finding: Whole new file equals the retained previous file after only changing immediate derivation and binding each streamed preflight generator to its own already-qualified receipt.

checks.name: provenance_precedes_stream_reading
checks.finding: provenance() runs successfully before captures(); it pins the precise retained A receipt/report/generator and matches B to the current capture generator.

checks.name: role_binding_not_relaxed
checks.finding: The per-role receipt is selected from the same baseline/candidate loop as the streamed row. Its generator was already exactly matched to the permitted generator for that role, including before/after equality and frozen input inclusion.

checks.name: remaining_shared_generator_assumptions
checks.finding: Remaining this.captureTool uses bind the new candidate generator or label current output provenance; no remaining streamed A row is compared to B generator.

checks.name: semantic_controls_unchanged
checks.finding: Graph reconstruction, full raw values, differences, clocks, owner checks, command/return binding, counts, schemas and final source pins are byte-unchanged outside the exact two-line delta.

checks.name: capture_reuse_supported
checks.finding: Final candidate capture source does not import or fingerprint a qualifier, so replacing only the separately planned reader cannot change or invalidate the successful capture.

checks.name: failed_attempt_preserved
checks.finding: Actual failed wrapper and report match amendment fingerprints; the next manually declared output is a separate attempt.

qualification: Ready for the separately declared bounded reader-only attempt. This static review does not claim that the reader has passed, grant official timing eligibility, or require regenerating an unchanged successful capture.
